verdict.rationale: A built-in assistant is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only MCP servers and an agent-skills plugin that let external coding agents control Runpod. Those are integrations for third-party agents, not an assistant inside the product, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
